tldr: Moon in the 6th house: emotional needs and comfort center on work, health, and routine
body: Moon in the 6th house: emotional needs and comfort center on work, health, and routine. Gift: deep feeling there. Watch: moods ride on it. With the Moon in the 6th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
